faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NBRC Research Assistant-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the NBRC Research Assistant-III post is 22nd August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant-III position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Research Assistant-III position, candidates must possess an M.Sc or B.Tech degree or an equivalent Master's degree from a nationally recognized institute, along with a minimum of 4 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant-III post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant-III post is 35 years. There might be age relaxations for certain categories as per government rules, which will be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant-III position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant-III position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000 per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NBRC Research Assistant-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NBRC Research Assistant-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories is ₹ 200. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form as per the instructions in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant-III role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant-III position will primarily be based on an interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Research Assistant-III position at NBRC is a contractual job. The duration of the contract will be specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the National Brain Research Centre (NBRC) located?
faq.answer: The National Brain Research Centre (NBRC) is located in Gurugram, Haryana, with the pincode 122052.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of the National Brain Research Centre (NBRC). Links are provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
